steps: Investigate the Airflow scheduler pod events to determine why it stopped heartbeating, using `get_k8s_events(pod="scheduler")`.
Check if the deployment was scaled down or if the container crashed (e.g., OOMKilled or CrashLoopBackOff).
Based on the failure reason, take the corrective action specified in the Decison table: scale back if scaled to 0, or increase resource limits/fix image tags if it crashed.
